projects.teaser: Satellite land-cover change detector for agricultural monitoring.
projects.title: TerraWatch
projects.solution: Combined Earth Engine time-series analysis with a Python/Geopandas backend, surfacing change heatmaps on a MapLibre GL viewer.
projects.problem: Regional agencies lacked an accessible way to monitor deforestation and land-use change over time.

projects.teaser: Municipal asset management WebGIS for utility infrastructure.
projects.title: GeoServe Analytics
projects.solution: Delivered a GeoServer/PostGIS backend with an Angular dashboard for asset lifecycle tracking and map-based inspection scheduling.
projects.problem: A municipal utility tracked infrastructure assets across disconnected spreadsheets and paper maps.

projects.teaser: Predictive flood risk mapping using terrain and rainfall data.
projects.title: FloodRisk AI
projects.solution: Fused DEM-derived terrain features with rainfall forecasts in a Python model, serving risk zones through Firebase to a Turf.js-powered map client.
projects.problem: Flood-prone districts had no forward-looking risk model to guide evacuation planning.

projects.teaser: Indoor/outdoor wayfinding app for a university campus.
projects.title: CampusNav
projects.solution: Built a React + MapLibre GL wayfinding app with Supabase-backed routing graphs spanning indoor floor plans and outdoor paths.
projects.problem: New students struggled to navigate a sprawling campus with mixed indoor/outdoor routes.
